author: blu
body: The tool never proposes DELETE. Whether a block explains our own code is a judgement, and a keyword classifier answering it would be an instrument that cannot fail: every block gets an answer and nothing says which answers are wrong. So the proposal is KEEP or ANNOTATE, the worst automated outcome is prose moved to a sidecar rather than lost, and DELETE is a word only the auditor writes.

author: blu
body: Rule 12 justifies prose in three cases and each names itself. External things we do not own cite a datasheet, a section, a register, a wire format. Magic numbers appear as literals. Performance and crackability characteristics talk about attackers, work factors and bounds. These are the tunable part of the tool; the auditor who disagrees with a verdict edits a pattern here and re-runs phase one.

author: blu
body: A document reference in source prose was dead 24 times out of 24, measured across the tree 2026-07-27. It is reported as a signal and never acted on: a dead pointer inside an otherwise good block is a reason to edit the block, not to drop it.
